name: @civ-clone/ui-models-builtin
description: The 3D map's built-in model set (docs/3d-renderer.md §10, D3): what's made by code, so every name always has something. The terrain table, each terrain's relief and colour; the unit table, what each unit type is drawn as; the specials table, what each terrain feature looks like; and the vegetation table, what grows on each terrain.
